finalText:
**4.2.0 notes written to [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md).**

Out of 380 commits, most were dep bumps and pure refactors. One breaking change, one feature, nine fixes made the cut.

Breaking: several modules stopped re-exporting their internal error types.

Added: webhook retries now use exponential backoff.

Fixed: expired-token status code, full request body logging, null-cursor crashes, duplicate headers, double-trimmed slashes, empty allowlists, dropped trace ids, wrong histogram units, unclear token errors.

Next: review the wording before you publish.
